Winners of the November 3, 2026 election take office in January 2027: update this list then. pdc_person_ids lists the Public Disclosure Commission records of state or local campaigns, added only after checking office, place and years, so they survive a blank member row; surnames alone are never enough (the Adam Smith and Gary Locke in the PDC's records are other people).
